data.content: The best mechanic on the western slope and his crippled buddy (me) lol are in need of a house to rent in the Fruita area if possible. ASAP!!! Minimum of two bedrooms and would prefer a garage. Any help would be greatly appreciated. Private landlord preferred as well. TIA 🍀🙏

For rent
Home in Kings view estates approximately 1900 sq ft, 3 bed, 2.5 bath. Main floor has kitchen, Living room,  half bath and primary bedroom with full bath.

Lower level has 2 beds, laundry hook up, full bath, office and central recreation room. 

Great neighborhood, nice views. Close to hiking, biking and snooks bottom. 

Home has central air and heat  and solar panels to offset electricity usage.

Tenants responsible for all utilities except water, sewer and trash. 

$2400 per month plus $5000 security deposit. 

Call Mario 970-925-6881

DM here or text 7013902027

All horse quality and stored in shelter from day 1, no rain. 

$15.00/bale for 80/20

You pick up and load, 20 mins north of Fruita.  No delivery.
